title: The Equipment Lease You Could Never Escape
one_paragraph_summary: Northern Leasing Systems and affiliated companies locked small business owners nationwide into abusive, overpriced, non-cancelable leases for credit-card processing equipment — then, when businesses fell behind or tried to walk away, filed over 30,000 lawsuits in New York City Civil Court and won more than 19,000 default judgments, often against owners who were never properly served or lived out of state. New York's Attorney General won a court order in 2020 vacating roughly 30,000 of those default judgments and dissolving Northern Leasing Systems, Inc.; in 2024 the AG secured a further $4.6 million in restitution after finding the same operators had spun up new entities to keep running the scheme.
victim_type: small businesses that leased credit-card processing equipment
dollar_amount_if_any: 30,000+ default judgments vacated; $4.6 million+ additional restitution in 2024
named_parties: Northern Leasing Systems, Inc.; Lease Finance Group; MBF Leasing; NLS Equipment Finance LLC; Leasing Expenses Company, LLC
why_it_hooks: They sued 30,000 small businesses and won almost all of it by default — because most owners never even knew they'd been sued.
verification_notes: Three separate primary NY AG press releases (2016 suit, 2020 dissolution/judgment-vacatur, 2024 follow-on restitution) give a clean three-act structure. After dissolution, the AG found the SAME operators running the scheme through new shell entities — verify that specific 'they came back under a new name' detail directly in the 2024 release before using it as the twist.
